# SmartPrints Hub — Commercial Printing, Corporate Branding & Cyber Services

> SmartPrints Hub is the premier commercial printing, corporate merchandising, and digital cyber services hub based in Westlands Market, Shop A11, Nairobi, Kenya. We deliver high-speed, high-resolution offset, digital, and large-format printing for startups, corporate brands, educational institutions, NGOs, and individuals.

## Core Business Entities & Facts
- **Business Name**: SmartPrints Hub
- **Canonical Website**: https://www.smartprintshub.co.ke/
- **Physical Address**: Westlands Market, Shop A11, Woodvale Grove, Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +254 743 603 068 / +254 708 127 992
- **Email**: smartprintershub1@gmail.com
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/smartprinters_hub_westlands?dlrf=dDd5MnBjcXRrYTB0 (@smartprinters_hub_westlands)
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Saturday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM (EAT). Closed Sundays.
- **Service Areas**: Westlands, Nairobi CBD, Kilimani, Upper Hill, Parklands, Karen, Lavington, Gigiri, and across Kenya via courier parcel dispatch.
- **Accepted Payments**: M-Pesa (Till & Paybill), Cash, Bank Transfer, Visa / Mastercard.
- **Turnaround Speed**: Express same-day turnaround (orders confirmed by 11:00 AM); Standard turnaround 24 hours.

## Primary Services & Products

### 1. Large Format & Event Signage
- **Retractable Roll-Up Banners**: Standard (85x200cm) and Broadbase luxury stands with high-definition matte/glossy tear-resistant vinyl.
- **Teardrop & Telescopic Banners**: Single or double-sided flags for outdoor trade fairs and corporate events.
- **Conference Backdrops & Media Walls**: Tension fabric, step-and-repeat event photo backdrops.
- **Vinyl Posters & Vinyl Stickers**: High-gloss, matte, waterproof die-cut stickers and vehicle branding.

### 2. Corporate Stationery & Marketing Collateral
- **Executive Business Cards**: 350gsm – 400gsm art card with matte/gloss lamination, gold/silver foil stamping, embossing, and spot UV varnish.
- **Marketing Flyers & Brochures**: A6, A5, A4 flyers on 130gsm – 250gsm gloss art paper (single or tri-fold).
- **Custom Presentation Folders**: Interlocking or glued pockets with business card slots.
- **Branded Hardcover Notebooks & Diaries**: Embossed or UV printed executive notebooks with pen loops and elastic bands.

### 3. Branded Apparel & Promotional Merchandise
- **Corporate T-Shirts & Polo Shirts**: Screen-printed and embroidered 100% cotton polo and round-neck shirts.
- **Branded Mugs & Water Flasks**: Ceramic sublimation mugs, double-wall stainless steel thermal bottles.
- **Custom Umbrellas**: Windproof corporate golf umbrellas with vibrant multi-panel silk screen printing.
- **Lanyards & PVC Identity Cards**: Sublimation satin lanyards and plastic employee ID cards with RFID or barcodes.

### 4. Digital & Cyber Government Services
- **eCitizen Government Portal**: Fast-track business name registration, CR12 official searches, driving license renewals.
- **KRA Tax Services**: New KRA PIN registration, annual individual and corporate income tax return filing, VAT compliance certificates.
- **Visa & Passport Photography**: Strictly biometric embassy-compliant visa photos (US, UK, Schengen, Canada, East Africa).
- **Document Services**: High-speed color photocopying, scanning, laminating, thesis coil/wire/hardcover binding.

## Representative Client Showcase & Portfolio
- **Google Cloud Gemini Masterclass**: High-end corporate event suite, executive embossed notebooks, and twin roll-up banner stands.
- **African Development Bank (AfDB)**: Large freestanding fabric stage backdrop and Pullman Hotel conference banners.
- **VIBIT Agricultural Training College**: Roll-up promotional banners and coffee academy career flyers.
- **Alpine Fine Art Boardroom Decor**: High-definition framed landscape wall art.
